tagline: A political compass test with a new design and new questions.
info_questions: Answer questions about your political views with 5 levels of agreement.
info_flag: Get a unique flag and a breakdown of your positions across multiple axes.
info_share: Share your results with a short link — your answers stay private.
about_subtitle: A re-implementation of the Politiscales test with a new design and new questions.
about_what_body: Politiscales is a political compass that goes beyond the classic left–right spectrum. Instead of placing you on a single axis, it measures your positions across multiple paired and unpaired axes to give a richer picture of your political identity.
about_axes_body: Your answers are scored across 10 paired axes (each pair represents two opposite tendencies) and 7 independent axes that are only shown when your score crosses a threshold:
about_axes_unpaired: Independent axes (shown as badges when your score is high enough):
about_scoring_body: Each question contributes a weighted score to one or more axes. For paired axes, the combined score of each pair is normalized so the two sides never exceed 100 % together. The remaining percentage represents a neutral or mixed position. Unpaired axes are shown as a badge only when you score above a certain threshold.
about_legacy_body: Results from the original Politiscales test (encoded in the URL query string) are automatically detected and converted to the new format so they can still be viewed.
